body:
Source: whole-repo bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2). `packages/core/test/core.test.mjs` contains 45 `try/finally` blocks that manually clean up tempdirs created with `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), ...))`. Following the introduction of `@adlc/core/test-kit` in #1098, `core.test.mjs` can eat its own dogfood by importing `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from `../lib/test-kit.mjs` with automatic `t.after` lifecycle cleanup.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/core/test/core.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from '../lib/test-kit.mjs'.
   - Update test cases to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix))` calls with `tmp(t, prefix)`.
   - Remove all 45 `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. Ensure all core tests pass: `npm test -w packages/core`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/core/test/core.test.mjs` reports 0 (down from 45).
- AC2 `npm test -w packages/core` exits 0 with all test cases passing.
- AC3 `adlc rails-guard` and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exit 0.
title: refactor(core): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit in core.test.mjs and eliminate 45 try/finally blocks
